g1.label: 1. the car was most common in A, ___ bicycles were first in B
g1.why: “Whereas” links two contrasting facts in one sentence; “because” and “so” would mean one fact caused the other.

g2.label: 2. the share of car users was ___ that in Country B
g2.why: 48% is four times 12%; “twice” would be 24% and “half” 6%.

g3.label: 3. public transport in Country C: ___ of students (45%)
g3.why: 45% is a little below 50%, so it is just under half.

g4.label: 4. Country B had ___ of cyclists of the four countries
g4.why: At 44%, Country B’s cycling figure is far above A (6%), C (9%) and D (12%).

g5.label: 5. only 6% cycled in A, ___ 44% in Country B
g5.why: “Compared with” sets one figure against another; 6% is not similar to 44%.

g6.label: 6. walking in Country D: ___ of students (28%)
g6.why: A quarter is 25%, so 28% is just over a quarter.

g7.label: 7. Countries A and C had ___ of walkers, at 16%

g8.label: 8. car use in C (30%) was ___ in Country D (24%)
g8.why: 30% is above 24%, but only by 6 percentage points.

g1.why: A quarter is 25%, and 26% is one point above it.

g2.why: Half is 50%, and 49% is just below it.

g3.label: 3. 90 compared with 30
g3.why: 90 ÷ 30 = 3, so it is three times as many; “three more” would be 33.

g4.why: Three quarters is 75%, and 74% is just below it.

g5.why: A third is about 33%, so 32% is roughly a third.

g6.why: Half is 50%, and 52% is a little above it.

g7.why: One in ten is 10%, so 9% is fewer than one in ten.

g8.label: 8. 20 compared with 40
g8.why: 20 is half of 40; “twice as many” would be 80.

g1.correct: Overall, travel habits differed widely: driving was most common in Country A, cycling in Country B and public transport in Countries C and D.
accept: Overall, travel habits differed widely: driving was most common in Country A, cycling in Country B and public transport in Countries C and D.
g1.label: 1. Overview: travel to university
g1.why: An overview names the main features with no detailed figures; the other options list numbers or give an opinion.

g2.correct: Overall, the Science museum attracted far more visitors than the other two.
accept: Overall, the Science museum attracted far more visitors than the other two.
g2.label: 2. Overview: museum visitors
g2.why: It states the biggest difference without figures; Task 1 never asks for your opinion.

g3.correct: Overall, the older the students were, the more time they spent on homework.
accept: Overall, the older the students were, the more time they spent on homework.
g3.label: 3. Overview: homework hours
g3.why: It sums up the pattern across all three groups; the other options list figures or judge the data.

g4.correct: Overall, younger adults preferred online news, while older adults read newspapers far more.
accept: Overall, younger adults preferred online news, while older adults read newspapers far more.
g4.label: 4. Overview: what adults read
g4.why: It contrasts the two groups’ main habits without numbers or opinion.

g5.label: 5. rose ___ 12% to 27% (review)
g5.why: “From … to …” gives the start and end figures — recalled from ielts-writing-task1-describing-trends.html (Ex C).

g6.label: 6. There was a ___ in bus use (review)
g6.why: After “a”, use adjective + noun — recalled from ielts-writing-task1-describing-trends.html (Ex B).
